dashboard.noPeriodicPlugin: Daily Notes or Periodic Notes plugin is required

settings.title: Obsidian Widgets
settings.languageDesc: Language used for widget labels. 'Auto' follows Obsidian's language setting.
settings.captureTemplatesDesc: Buttons available in all daily widgets. If a widget defines its own `captures:` in YAML, those take priority. Available tokens: {text} (user input), {time} (current HH:mm), {task} (shorthand for '- [ ] {text}'). Write \n for a line break (useful for callouts: "> [!note]\n> {text}"). The heading field is optional — leave empty to group entries under an hour block (## HH:00).
settings.gratitudeAutoTagDesc: Tag added to the daily note's frontmatter on the first gratitude entry. Without '#'. Can be overridden per-widget with `gratitude.tag` in YAML. Leave empty to disable.
settings.excludedTagPrefixesDesc: Tags starting with these prefixes are excluded from the weekly summary top-tags list. E.g. 'tipo/' will exclude 'tipo/diario', 'tipo/work', etc.
settings.tagColorsDesc: Map note tags to colored dots shown under each day in the monthly widget.
settings.linkColorsDesc: Map note links to colored dots shown under each day. Enter the filename without extension.
settings.frontmatterColorsDesc: Map frontmatter property values to colored dots. Example: property 'mood', value 'happy'.
settings.sectionWeatherDesc: Location used by weather widgets when no location is specified in the YAML block.
settings.locationDesc: Display name shown in the weather card (optional).
settings.unitsDesc: Default unit used when a widget does not specify its own.
